Lena: Heads-up: tonights change window includes runtime v5.2 (kernel tweak), router header-split, API v2.6. Need pin/unpin order and tight rollback rules.
Marcus: I'm runtime oncall. Suggest order: dedicated runtime canary -> warm caches -> router canary -> API thin rollout -> console deploy -> unpin.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled rollout 1789999800. Waves: dedicated-canary(2 hosts) -> hosted 5% -> 25% -> full. Ticket INF-2109.
Ivy: Console schema adds route.flag. Backwards compatible but UI may show empty cells until API returns new field; deploy after API at 25%.
Omar: Rollback triggers: sustained 3m user 5xx +2% abs OR p95 +200ms OR KV miss +10% absolute. On trigger: stop expansion, rollback router/API, then runtime if issue persists.
Lena: Add model token error spike as a trigger for hosted customers.
Marcus: Canary plan: runtime 5% 10m, expand to 25% 15m. Warmup step 8-10m between waves.
Ivy: I'll hold console deploy until you confirm API stable at 25%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] prechecks: quant-profile locked=true, canary hosts healthy=true. Initiating dedicated canary in 2m. Status updates posted to ticket.
Lena: I'll ping #support and #enterprise when API hits 25%. Monitor: infra.kv_miss_rate, runtime.evictions, api.5xx, router.header_fallback.
Marcus: On standby to revert runtime.
Ivy: Merging console PR blocked until API steady.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] thread paused until first canary completes. Use /release abort INF-2109 for emergency rollback.
